hook: HC to govt: *ensure water* for all, file drought affidavit by Dec 9
hook_b: HC to govt: *ensure water* for all, file drought affidavit by Dec 9
tldr: Hearing a PIL on El Niño-induced drought, the Telangana High Court said its concern is not how the government sources water but whether every citizen gets it, and sought a detailed affidavit. The case returns on December 9.

beats.what: A bench of Acting Chief Justice P Sam Koshy and Justice Suddala Chalapathi Rao said the situation 'was not man-made and the govt cannot be blamed', but asked for the measures taken, per TOI.
beats.why: Telangana got 630.1 mm of rain from June 1 to Oct 31 against a normal 833.1 mm, a 24% deficit, per the petitioners.
beats.care: The petitioners' counsel said the western parts of Hyderabad, the IT corridor, are among the worst hit, and that hundreds of hostels have closed over water scarcity.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: 365 of the state's 621 mandals have been declared drought-affected, the petitioners told the court; another 254 face similar conditions.

cards.q: What matters most in the drought response?

qs: How will the government's affidavit measure whether water reaches every citizen?
Which parts of Hyderabad depend most on tankers this season?

facts.t: Telangana needs about *409 tmc* of drinking water; about *200 tmc* is available, petitioners said.
Besides 365 drought mandals, *254 more* face similar conditions, per the PIL.

viz.verdict: 24% less rain than normal, per the petitioners
More than half the state's mandals, per the petition

learn.t: PIL = public interest litigation, a case filed in the public's interest rather than for a private dispute.

watch: The government's affidavit on drinking water measures at the December 9 hearing.
